translations.web: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.
translations.bsb: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
translations.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
translations.asv: And except those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
